blocks.text: Rein Entertainment has unveiled the official trailer for psychological thriller “Laya,” featuring Andrea Brillantes and JC Santos navigating a complicated friendship marked by secrets and unexpected turns. Released on Thursday, Nov. 5, the nearly two-minute clip begins with Brillantes’ character, Sab, seemingly plotting her revenge against Santos’ Tuki, an ex-convict who was imprisoned for murder.
